ctx.x: Tell me more about Jelly Roll.

[Chuckles] Well, what do you want to know about Jelly Roll? He was a...I don't know...Jelly Roll was a...aww, he was sincere about what he said, but everything he said was so foolish. He tried...I think he tried to sue ASCAP because he thought they was stealing his stuff. He tried...wanted to sue everybody that played any jazz or anything he said is stealing from them, and he wanted to sue them and everything. [Laughs] He think he started all of that.
